species.real: A queen conch can make pearls, pink and glossy, but they are rare and very hard to farm, so every one is a lucky find.
species.name: Conchling

dex.text: Mutters to itself in a voice like the sea in a shell, which is exactly what it is. Fritters are not mentioned in front of it.
dex.fact: The queen conch is a large sea snail of the Caribbean; its meat is eaten in fritters and salads, and the Turks and Caicos has a long-running conch fishery and farm.

species.real: A queen conch has eyes on stalks and gets about by vaulting, digging a sickle-shaped plate on its foot into the sand and hopping forward.
species.name: Conchord

dex.text: A shell like a pink trumpet and a temper like a shut door. Hold it to your ear and it will tell you what it thinks of you.
dex.fact: The queen conch's shell has a flared pink lip, and the 'sound of the sea' in any shell is really the air around your ear resonating, not the ocean.
